rows.text: I choose you because Doctor Voss would never suspect you.
Listen to Mr. Filmon of Terminus Post.
Rescue Kilmor. Search the Halls of the Colossi and bring back his journal.
Attend Kilmor's funeral in the Crag-Folk Burial Vaults.
Find the Sun Priestess in the Sun-Ziggurat. Old Chronos knows the way.
Find the Drowned citadel. Its gate answers to the Drowned Key or great infamy.
Meet Lord Wood at his War-Camp. His plan is our best hope.
Stand before Voss in the Basalt Fastness and perform the Calling. Lord Wood will come.
The Resonator is bound to you now. You cannot put it down.
The shrine-intellect grants the Sun-Mind's Boon. Use it in the enclosed places of the Plateau.
Welcome to Kilmor's burial. You may greet the guests; the rite begins when you take your seat.
A black-robed phantasm appears above the casket: Doctor Voss, projected by mesmerism.
Thermal rays from emplaced devices sweep the guest rows. Chairs blacken; the guests fall.

I am Doctor Voss. What I have done today is small work. Only those who take my cause will thrive in the world I am making. I will burn out every last spark of decency on this plateau — but those who join me will be rewarded.
A hideous laugh rolls through the vaults.
The broadcast fades. Charred bodies and empty chairs surround the casket.
Welcome below, friends of the crag-folk and mesa-folk.
Only crag-folk and mesa-folk are welcome below.
Take an egg from my great viper without striking her — and without being struck.
You have proven your patience. Take the Old Master-Bow.
The air is bad. Come back later.
The sweet scent draws the viper closer. It is an attractant.
For all the dollars you carry, and a measure of your memories of blood and victory, I will teach you the fifty-seventh rite — the Calling.
You hold the Calling. You will know its hour.
Beware the Great Beast. The foul bottle keeps the viper away; sweetness draws her close.
Monday — Time-Space Reclamation. Tuesday — Matter-Energy Transference. Wednesday — the Sun-Ziggurat.
Old Chronos studies the party, murmurs about his moving station, and falls asleep.
Set C2+ for the Sun-Ziggurat. Take the glowing key from the cracked ceiling-lens chamber.
The Drowned Ziggurat mirrors its twin. Set C2− and remember your steps.
I cannot do anything else for you
The crystalline sun-gate will open only to the Sun-Key.

Old Chronos said you would come… go to the Drowned Ziggurat, the mirror of this one, beneath the crater lake. Its gate answers only to great infamy — or to the Drowned Key, which lies in the Halls of the Colossi. Do the opposite of all you did here, and remember your steps.
You haven't done enough infamy to enter here.
Your conduct is doubtful. You have not yet earned entry.
Enter, infamous ones.
The Drowned Key turns. Voss is not in.
WELCOME PILGRIMS TO MY CITY. TAKE MY CAUSE AND SLAY LORD WOOD, AND GREAT SHALL BE YOUR REWARD. TO FIND ME, BREAK THE RESONATOR UPON THE GLYPH-CIRCLE IN MY SANCTUM.
The Resonator binds itself to your hand; you cannot get rid of it.

…We must find Voss in the Ember Deeps and destroy him there. If I lock him in a duel of wills while you strike, we may prevail. Go to his fastness; when you stand before him, perform the fifty-seventh rite. It will open a path through which I will come.
Go to the Hidden Enclave. The Old Mesmerist holds the fifty-seventh rite.
I will repeat the plan. Find Voss in the Ember Deeps; perform the Calling before him, and I will come.
You are too pure and good for my purposes. Prepare to die, fools.
You have shown some appetite for the dark. Prove yourselves truly mine — destroy Lord Wood.
You have proven your nature utterly. One test remains: destroy Lord Wood, and kneel to me.
You do not hold that rite, fool.
There is no noticeable effect at this distance.

A black ether-gate opens. Lord Wood steps through. "Strike now! Strike at Doctor Voss!" Voss cries: "No — destroy Lord Wood, and I will raise you beside me." A blue arc joins the two men. Smoke rises; their coats char as the duel of wills holds them motionless.
You kept faith with the Light. The Plateau remembers its friends.
You have the makings of an apostle of the Deep. Go out, and teach others your ways.
I am Doctor Voss. You would not like to see what it costs. Join me — and you never will.
